facts.fact: The BCEAO told every bank, e-money issuer and payment institution in the eight WAEMU states, Benin included, in April to be connected to PI-SPI by 30 June 2026; on 25 June it moved the deadline to 30 September 2026 for them and to 30 June 2027 for microfinance institutions, per iAfrikan.

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions, microfinance institutions
